conditions.location: Natural Eldritch altar/obelisk with DARK aura node directly above altar.
conditions.wand: Reusable ItemWandCasting with enough capacity and stored vis; not consumed.
conditions.visCostMeaning: Base displayed wand-vis units before wand/gear crafting consumption modifiers. This is not essentia; actual debited vis uses ItemWandCasting.getConsumptionModifier.
conditions.accounting: Four Eldritch Eyes and wand-vis cost belong to opening one portal/expedition infrastructure. Do not charge four Eyes separately for every boss or Pearl.

steps: Complete OCULUS research and locate an eligible Eldritch altar.
Insert four Eldritch Eyes; each insertion consumes one eye.
After maze generation is ready, activate using a charged wand.
Enter Outer Lands and progress through its maze to a boss encounter.

recipes.machineType: Conditional natural acquisition: defeat Eldritch Warden

inputs.role: Reusable access prerequisite; portal opening is an expedition sidequest

conditions.location: Outer Lands boss encounter; find a Warden encounter, not a guaranteed Warden in every room.
conditions.dropRule: Base boss dropFewItems unconditionally calls entityDropSpecialItem with new ItemStack(ConfigItems.itemEldritchObject,1,3). No random roll or fortune-dependent quantity in this method.
conditions.lootCondition: Normal enabled mob drops; events or server rules must not suppress drops.
conditions.otherDropsNotCounted: The same boss method also drops one rare loot bag; this patch models the Pearl only.

steps: Reach and defeat an Eldritch Warden.
Collect the one Primordial Pearl special-item drop.

sourceProvenance.analysis: Selective CFR0.152 decompilation of boss superclass/Warden, portal altar and wand activation classes only.

scopeNotes: Boss combat gear and the whole wand crafting chain intentionally remain conditions; explicit portal-consumed items and base vis are shown.
Primordial Pearl acquisition does not depend on already having a Pearl or the cyclic conversion/loot-machine route.
